summary.text: Matthew Pitaro is a Republican state representative from Merrimack District 11 who has served since December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary.

paragraphs.text: Pitaro lives in Allenstown, New Hampshire, and graduated from Manchester High School West in 2005, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists him as assigned to the House Transportation Committee in the 2021-2022 session.
